Subscriptions only. Never introduce API-key spending. Free tiers and local models are fine.
Verify through the front door: check the outcome in the system of record, never trust a tool reporting its own success.
Pin explicit model ids, never aliases. "opus" silently resolved to claude-opus-4-7 for weeks.
Postgres is the only source of truth. Never write state, plans or handoffs to markdown files — research notes are the sole exception.
The Android SDK is at C:/workspace/AppData/Local/Android/Sdk and the JDK ships with Android Studio at C:/Program Files/Android/Android Studio/jbr.

The gateway runs on 127.0.0.1:8787 (local, trusted, grants desktop authority without authentication) and 127.0.0.1:8788 (tunnel, requires a verified Cloudflare Access token). Restarting it also restarts the supervisor.
